decision: Use a transparent linear model and keyword baseline before considering a more complex model; freeze the split and error taxonomy.
credible_alternatives: Use a large language model classifier; deferred because reproducibility, data exposure and baseline interpretability would remain unresolved.
criteria: Route fit; evidence production; feasibility; authority; reversibility
evidence_and_authority: Keyword-rule baseline versus regularised linear classifier, with held-out evaluation, calibration and class-specific error analysis.
assumptions_and_risks: Synthetic language, label design, split dependence, class imbalance and absence of distribution-shift testing.
conditional_commitment: Use a transparent linear model and keyword baseline before considering a more complex model; freeze the split and error taxonomy.
early_test: Verify label consistency, leakage controls, a trivial majority baseline and deterministic preprocessing before training.
reopening_trigger: Failed early evidence reopens Design Gate; unavailable or unauthorised evidence reopens Problem or Evidence Gate.
